note: Normalized record of the per-asset prompt set. AI-assisted cutouts, not literal pixel crops.
sharedConstraints: Extract only the named figure from its specified row of the edit-target character sheet. One isolated mascot on a square canvas with modest 8% padding. Preserve expression, pose, proportions, gold graduation cap, cream pages, green left/orange right book cover, blue/purple speech-bubble wings, white gloves, 3D shading and associated props. Remove other figures, labels, panels, logos, sheet background and ground plane. Genuine transparent PNG alpha, not drawn checkerboard or solid backdrop. No redesign or unrelated elements. Expression busts: no added legs. Action poses: keep whole figure and props uncut.
